definition: Zealous means filled with intense eagerness or enthusiasm for a cause.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word zealous. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know zealous should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The new hall monitor proved so zealous about the no-running rule that teachers began taking the long corridor just to avoid her clipboard.
Eager wants to start; zealous has already started, recruited three friends, and printed the handouts.
Fanatical pushes past zealous and loses the compliment: the zealous fan paints her face, while the fanatical one keys the rival team's bus.

Avid describes sheer appetite for an activity, enjoyed for its own sake — the avid reader devours novels by the stack. Zealous adds a cause and a crusading edge: the enthusiasm serves a mission and pulls others in. An avid gardener loves her roses; a zealous one lobbies the city for community plots.

Passionate says strong feeling drives you, whatever the object — a passionate cook, a passionate defense of a friend. Zealous narrows the feeling to a cause and turns it outward into tireless public action. Passion can burn quietly at home; a zealous believer is out signing people up.

Keen marks eager interest at its mildest — keen on chess, a keen student of maps. Zealous is that same eagerness at full boil and attached to a cause, spilling into evenings and weekends. A keen supporter shows up to the rally; a zealous one organized it.
barely interested at all
giving only partial effort

Histories of the city's park system all begin with Mira Chen, a seamstress who decided in 1911 that every child deserved shade within a five-minute walk.
Chen was zealous in a way the city had not seen: she spoke at six churches a Sunday, signed up shopkeepers by the hundred, and turned petition drives into street festivals.
Reporters noted that she did not especially enjoy gardening; the trees were never the point.
The cause was everything, and by 1920 her volunteers had planted eleven thousand elms.
Asked to rest, she famously answered that she would rest when the last block had its shade.
